scope: Select and exercise a non-T4 Flash-Next native-MTP MXFP4 QAT lane, including explicit gradient checkpointing and a matched on-demand A6000 comparison.

occupancy.decision: The only GPU occupant is the intended embedding service, so Strix is available but shares only about 5.6 GiB VRAM.

memory_boundary.conclusion: The full frozen base alone exceeds Strix's free VRAM. Gradient checkpointing saves activations, not the 7.22 GiB frozen weight footprint; a Strix GPU run would require CPU/offload, a quantized-resident base, or pausing the embedding service.

modal.conclusion: The recurring Modal lane has no remaining monthly headroom.

other_lanes.runpod: Wallet balance $0.00 and displayed GPU inventory was Low stock.
other_lanes.vast: Wallet balance $0.00; verified on-demand offers existed around $0.17-$0.44/hour for older 24 GB GPUs, but the proven non-interruptible pod path was Prime.
other_lanes.packet: Packet account and balance CLI calls returned HTTP 404.
other_lanes.coreweave_forge: No sandboxes were listed and no GPU entitlement was granted.

source.verification: All 30 shards plus config and original safetensors index passed the local pinned SHA-256 manifest.

matched_16step.conclusion: On A6000 the two arms produced byte-identical artifacts. Checkpointing added 2.99 trainer seconds for 16 steps without lowering the 17.4 GiB resident footprint, so it is not needed on this host.

gradient_checkpointing_decision.implementation: FlashNextMTP now has explicit non-reentrant torch.utils.checkpoint support and the trainer exposes --gradient-checkpointing.
gradient_checkpointing_decision.strix: Correct and useful for CPU/offload experiments, but it cannot make the full frozen base fit in the 5.6 GiB left beside the embedding service.
gradient_checkpointing_decision.a6000: Correct but unnecessary; matched 16-step runs had the same resident footprint and byte-identical artifacts, with checkpointing slightly slower.
gradient_checkpointing_decision.future_strix_gpu_path: Use CPU/offload or a quantized-resident frozen base. Gradient checkpointing may then bound activation memory, but that combined path is not implemented or measured.

checks.command: uv run --frozen --extra dev python -m pytest tests/test_flashnext_mtp.py tests/test_flashnext_mtp_train.py tests/test_export_flashnext_mtp_checkpoint.py -q
checks.result: 13 focused tests passed locally and on Strix.
Strix and three A6000 runs synced to private W&B Forge.
Pod terminated; Prime reports zero pods.

non_claims: The bank is still one private prompt; the 60.78% same-prompt top-1 result is not session-disjoint acceptance and may be memorization.
No candidate is integrated into Strata serving or promoted.
A6000 GPU utilization is low, indicating Python expert dispatch and loading dominate; this is not a kernel throughput claim.
Strix GPU training was not attempted because the frozen weight footprint exceeds free VRAM.
No T4 or Colab runtime was used.
